item.text:
The module calculates order totals, applies promo codes, averages item values, and formats a receipt.

Bugs:

- [orders.js](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-qxBr6w/test/orders.js:5): `i <= items.length` accesses `items[items.length]`, causing a `TypeError`; use `<`.
- [orders.js](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-qxBr6w/test/orders.js:20): `averageItemPrice([])` yields `NaN` (and currently crashes through `calcTotal`); empty lists need defined handling.
- `averageItemPrice` divides a quantity-weighted total by number of line items; if “item price” means per unit, this calculation is incorrect.
